posts.title: Automatically setup remote tracking branch
posts.description: I learned this on CSharpFritz ’s stream : git config --global --add --bool push.autoSetupRemote true . This allows you to be able to just do git push and it’ll automatically setup a remote tracking branch on your default remote.
